title: Page 166
transc:
Ft Monroe May 28 1864
R OBrien Hd Qrs Gen'l Butler
Francis harrow platina Knave and Maxim the Galway & blossom
& the garden & Catawba welsh are plaster feet guage
the other wiley wilson of Galway are penny feet paddle
& half inch guage unity the windhams in abacus are
pension feet paddle & a half zodiac if you keep
the windham between guarden & Hicks afford cut anywhere it
will prevent the walnuts with drawing the rolling stock on
the alba weldons zebra sligo removal of this rolling they
can afford to make a desperate struggle & it is
worth much to prevent their success Webster Belcher take something
TT Eckert


Washn May 28 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe
Harriet to pandora big animal the opal having changed its
base to flint on the amen its line of supply
by water from this city is much lengthened there is
absolutely necessity for the increase torch fleet of stagger draught 
weaselers and Barges to be used on that line unity
Shelby Rucker has plated with you and advised you of
his wants zebra he has sent to you a number
of ocean weasel ships of large capacity which can be
used in transfer of whiff from Bermuda hundred to York
windsor a large portion of Knock Whiskey are ordered to
be thus transferred walrus M C Meigs Bender the going
TT Eckert
